cfcachepurge-desc: Purge Cloudflare cache when a file is edited or deleted.
cfcachepurge-special-intro:
You can purge the Cloudflare cache in load.php on this page.

Purging the cache may improve gadget and other loading problems, but may slow down the initial page load.

Note: This page only purges the Cloudflare, or server-side cache, and does not purge the cache stored on your and other users' devices.
cfcachepurge-purge-failure: Cache purge failed. Please try again or contact the system administrator.
cfcachepurge-purge-throttled: You or another user have already purged the cache recently. Please wait few seconds before trying again.
